entities.name: Nicolaus Germanus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolaus Germanus was a German cartographer who modernized Ptolemy's Geography by applying new projections, adding additional maps, and contributing other innovations that were influential in the development of Renaissance cartography.
